v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.root_cause: Pixal3D duplicates coincident positions across dense UV/normal islands; collapse decimation before welding tore those disconnected copies into visible surface gaps. The input image and base-colour alpha were not the cause.
v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.geometry_fix: Exact-position weld before skinning and no collapse decimation; 517,805 active triangles; source-level boundary topology retained instead of multiplying open edges.
v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.texture_fix: 4096 fully opaque base colour, 48px UV padding, isolated defect inpaint and 36,275 local colour-outlier replacements; alpha min/max 255/255.
v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.walk_run_fix: Reconstruct UpperArm_L/R clip deltas as parent-space X rotations around the rest quaternion; no runtime Z spread is added.
v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.sit_fix: Correct thigh and knee bend signs for Pixal3D's front-facing local -Z basis and add foot counter-rotation.
v392_topology_texture_motion_fix.browser_qa: Actual local Vite WebGL captures for clean Idle, side Sit and side Walk are stored in docs/qa/v392; full-game load also verified.
